why: A is a plain circle; B is the same circle with a cone inside: a triangle whose base is a curved line, plus a second curved line below it. C is an oval, so the answer is the oval with the same cone lying on its side: a triangle with a curved base bending outward and a second curve next to it. That is option 1. Option 2 is tempting, but its curves bend the wrong way (inward), and option 3 has straight lines.
trick: When the shape changes (circle to oval), copy what was added inside, and check that curves bend the same way.
